t: High above, there is a city full of light, where God's angels live. One of them is a great archangel. His name is Gabriel.
m: Narrator | hushed wonder, like opening a treasure box; slow; a smile on the name 'Gabriel' | at most 10.5 s
d: Picture: bedtime; you point at the stars and tell the child in a low voice what is up there. (Revelation 21:23; Luke 1:19)

t: Don't be afraid, little one! I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God.
m: Gabriel the archangel | warm, strong and gentle at once, a big brother kneeling down to a small child; a smile in the voice; the name said with quiet joy | at most 5.7 s
d: Picture: you kneel down to the eye level of a slightly scared child and smile. (Luke 1:13, 1:19)

t: God sends me to carry His good news to the people He loves.
m: Gabriel the archangel | kind, like telling a secret about his job; a little proud and happy | at most 4.5 s
d: Picture: you tell a child 'my job is to bring good news'. (Luke 1:19)

t: Long ago, when Daniel was praying, I flew to him to tell him: God loves you very much!
m: Gabriel the archangel | storytelling, bright; a little lift on 'flew'; tender on 'God loves you very much' | at most 6.8 s
d: Picture: you show with your hands how far you flew. (Daniel 9:21-23)

t: Later, I went to a young woman named Mary, and told her: you will have a baby boy, and you will name him Jesus!
m: Gabriel the archangel | joyful and full of wonder; slow and glowing on 'Jesus' | at most 8.8 s
d: Picture: you are telling someone the biggest good news there is. (Luke 1:26-31)

t: It's the best news in the whole world! Listen...
m: Gabriel the archangel | excited, building; a breath, then a hushed, drawn-out 'Listen', as if asking everyone to be still | at most 4.2 s
d: Picture: you lift the trumpet, eyes shining, and make the child prick up their ears. (Luke 2:10)

t: God loves you. Wherever you are, He is watching over you. So don't be afraid!
m: Gabriel the archangel | the heart of the story: slow, warm, very sure; a soft pause before 'So'; a smile on 'don't be afraid' | at most 7.0 s
d: Picture: your hand on your heart, looking into the child's eyes. (Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 121:7-8)

t: Next time, colour me in with your favourite colours! Goodbye for now!
m: Gabriel the archangel | playful and warm, a laugh in it; a big friendly goodbye | at most 5.0 s
d: Picture: you wave as you get ready to fly off. ()

t: Gabriel flew back up to heaven. And God's good news is for you, too!
m: Narrator | warm closing, speaking right to the child; a smile on the last words | at most 6.3 s
d: Picture: you close the picture book and stroke the child's hair. (Luke 2:10)
